purpose: Resolve same-name county/constituency collisions in the live Parliament roster without using historical documents as current-holder evidence.
source_table: CONSTITUENCY AND SPECIAL INTERESTS / MEMBER’S NAME
usage_rule: This file supplies seat-role classification only. Current member identity, party and elected status must still come from the live 13th-Parliament roster used by the P23 snapshot. A historical name match may exclude a candidate explicitly labelled CWR, but may never introduce or replace a current holder.
